This is about updating the email tied to an account after the original email no longer exists. Policy DOC-068 covers that: support verifies identity through alternative means (billing history, account-specific details) before updating email.

Thus we can answer: they need to contact support, provide alternative verification (billing history, account details), and then support will update email.
